title: Settings
coachNote: Shows your hand, win chance, pot odds, outs and a suggestion.
hudNote: VPIP, PFR and aggression for each player over the last hands at the table.
muckNote: At showdown, losers may skip showing. Winners always show.
fourColorNote: Black spades, red hearts, blue diamonds and green clubs.
runTwiceNote: When everyone is all-in and agrees, the rest of the deck is dealt twice and the pot is split.
